mission_vision.title: Mission, Vision and Values
mission_vision.intro: Cazador de Sueños Sigar SRL — Tradition, excellence and commitment

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To produce high-quality cigars using the finest tobacco leaves and specialized processes, satisfying our clients' expectations through excellence, responsibility, respect for our collaborators, and sustainable development of the tobacco industry.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be a cigar factory recognized nationally and internationally for the excellence of our products, artisanal tradition, constant innovation, and commitment to quality, bringing the flavor and culture of tobacco to the most demanding markets.

items.label: Quality
items.text: Maintain the highest standards at every stage of production.

items.label: Commitment
items.text: Fulfill responsibly with clients, collaborators, and partners.

items.label: Tradition
items.text: Preserve the legacy and culture of the cigar-making art.

items.label: Integrity
items.text: Act with honesty, ethics, and transparency.

items.label: Innovation
items.text: Continuously improve our processes and products.

items.label: Social and Environmental Responsibility
items.text: Contribute to community welfare and environmental care.
